title: Florida House, District 75
what_it_does: Represents District 75 (Parts of Charlotte, Sarasota) in the Florida House; votes on state laws and the state budget.
verified_ballot_note: Candidate list taken from the Florida Division of Elections, 2026 general election candidate list on 2026-09-18 (https://dos.elections.myflorida.com/candidates/CanList.asp); statuses Qualified/Unopposed only. Counties from the Legislature's district listings.

candidates.name: Danny Nix Jr.
candidates.occupation: Commercial real estate broker (Nix Commercial Group, Keller Williams); state representative for District 75 since 2024
candidates.background: Commercial Realtor who leads the Nix Commercial Group at Keller Williams Peace River Partners and is president of the Realtors of Punta Gorda-Port Charlotte-North Port-DeSoto. He previously chaired the Florida SouthWestern State College board and led the Economic Development Partnership of Charlotte County. Elected to the House in 2024; his website posts no issue positions.

roster_sources.title: Florida Division of Elections, 2026 general election candidate list

property_tax.summary: Mixed. Nix voted for HJR 1-F in the June 2026 special session, which put Amendment 3 on the ballot. At an October 2026 North Port event he said the amendment shifts costs to fees rather than cutting taxes, raised concerns about first responders and local bond ratings, and would not tell voters how to vote on it.
property_tax.quote: There’s never been a tax cut I didn’t love. But this isn’t a tax cut. It’s tax shift.

sources.title: Danny Nix, others talk property tax reform: 'eyes wide opened, be prepared' (yoursun.com)

immigration.summary: Voted yes on SB 2-C (2025), which created the State Board of Immigration Enforcement, required state help with federal detainers, barred driver licenses for unauthorized immigrants, and funded an Unauthorized Alien Transport Program.

sources.title: Florida House roll-call vote, SB 2-C (Immigration), passage 85-30

elections.summary: Voted yes on CS/CS/HB 991 when it passed the House on Feb. 25, 2026 and yes on final House passage March 12, 2026. CS/CS/HB 991 (2026), now law (Ch. 2026-26), requires the state to verify voters' U.S. citizenship using driver-license and other government records and removes student and retirement-home IDs from the IDs accepted at the polls.

record.item: Voted for CS/HJR 1-F (2026), the June 2026 joint resolution that placed Amendment 3 on the ballot to raise the non-school homestead exemption to $250,000 by 2028 and let counties and cities exempt homesteads entirely; because the vote sent the question to voters rather than cutting taxes itself, a vote for it is coded as leaning toward sharply reducing homestead property taxes rather than as full agreement.

candidates.name: Cynthia Butler
candidates.occupation: Retired nurse and nurse-union leader; former EMT/paramedic
candidates.background: Port Charlotte retired nurse, nurse-union leader and former EMT/paramedic who worked in banking before health care. A single mother, grandmother and great-grandmother, she says she relied on housing assistance while raising her family and has rebuilt after hurricanes from Charley to Milton.
